## Kinema 1.4.1

- **Audio languages in downloads.**
  - When iOS can't play a file as it is (MKV and the like), the server repackages it for the download, even at Original quality, and its copy can hold only one audio language. Until now that was always the file's default (often Japanese for anime), and choosing another language in the player did nothing.
  - **Choose the language when downloading:** the download sheet now has an **Audio** choice when the files have several languages, and remembers it. Set the default in Settings → Downloads → **Audio language**; keeping the next episodes downloaded uses it too.
  - **Other languages still play:** picking a language that isn't in the download plays it from your server, from where you are, when there's a connection (and says so when there isn't). The Audio panel marks the languages that aren't in the download.
  - The Downloads list shows **Original, repackaged · Japanese** for such copies, and holding one offers **Download in Another Language**.
  - Original files that keep all their languages (MP4) now switch more reliably, also when the file doesn't group its audio tracks the way iOS expects.
- **Tracks stay right after finding a subtitle.** Jellyfin numbers all of a video's tracks again when a subtitle is added (it lists subtitle files first). Kinema now follows the tracks across that, so the chosen audio and subtitles and a download's saved subtitles don't get mixed up.
- **Pause All / Resume All** sits next to the Downloads title as a glass button.

## Install

Download **Kinema.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/Kinema/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, downloads and settings. Kinema needs iOS 17 or later and a Jellyfin server (10.9 or later).
